messages:
riley: Heads up — pages didn't go out for the pagerflow alert group between 01:02-01:10 UTC. Customer reported they never got paged.
incident-bot: alert pf-20260201-113 triggered; attempted to page 3x but was suppressed by upstream proxy responses (3x 502).
dina: Was there a suppressor rule change? I was on a deploy around 00:58 but didn't touch suppressors.
kevin: I'm seeing 502s from notify-proxy at ~01:01:59 in the logs. Signature verification upstream failed in the proxy process.
matt: I rolled notify-proxy:v2 at 00:55 (small config/route tweak). Healthchecks passed but I did not exercise signed pager routes.
riley: Can someone run a quick curl to the pagerflow ingress to reproduce?
kevin: Running a quick check now:
```
curl -i -X POST https://notify-proxy.internal/pagerflow/ingress \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Incident-Sign: test' \
  -d '{}'
# -> 502 Bad Gateway
```
matt: deploy-bot: deploy notify-proxy:v2 -> v2.1 at 00:55 (by matt). Noted.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: notify-proxy:v2.1 rolled, health checks passed. Route /pagerflow was behind a new handler that didn't forward the X-Incident-Sign header to the signing middleware.
dina: Ok that aligns. Can we rollback or hotfix? Customers already affected.
matt: Rolling back to v2 now, ETA ~3m. I'll flip traffic and re-run tests.
ops-sheriff: Customer impact: 2 paying customers reported missed pages. Ops notified CS and oncall. Potential SLA exposure, keep me posted.
kevin: Rollback complete at 01:08 UTC. Re-tested the curl; now returns 200 and signing middleware sees header. Manual page triggered and delivered to oncall.
riley: Confirmed pages delivered at ~01:10. Thanks. Please start a postmortem.
dina: I'll create a short postmortem and action items: add a canary test for signed routes, include an automated header-forwarding test in deploy pipeline, and document rollback play for notify-proxy.
incident-bot: incident-bot: manual notification delivered to oncall at 01:10 UTC for pf-20260201-113.
matt: sorry about that — will add the route test to the next deploy gate.
